{{Top|leg}}
A '''pressure sensor''' or '''baromeroid sensor'''<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that reacted to changes in weight on its surface. It employed [[sense-plate]]s.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> The multi-component bomb that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Zorin Krasul]] was strapped to by [[Zora]] included a pressure sensor; [[Havoc Squad]] disarmed the sensor by depressurizing the room and disconnecting it.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
